reasoning_trace.description: Explain the System Mechanism and ISAC Coupling Mode found.
reasoning_trace.value: The system uses an orthogonal chirp division multiplexing (OCDM) waveform-based terahertz-over-fiber (ToF) system for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) applications. The OCDM waveform is generated through an inverse discrete Fresnel transform (IDFnT) and is compatible with OFDM ISAC waveforms. The system achieves a 32 Gbit/s data rate and 1.875 cm range resolution simultaneously at 0.14 THz.

The system's performance is also compared to an OFDM-based ToF system, showing improved performance in frequency-selective ISAC channels.

reasoning_trace.description: Identify the solved problems and remaining open challenges.
reasoning_trace.value: The paper solves the problem of achieving high-performance ISAC in the THz frequency band by using an OCDM waveform-based ToF system. The remaining open challenges include further improving the system's performance, such as increasing the data rate and range resolution, and exploring the system's applications in various fields, such as 6G wireless communication and sensing.
